input.title: Fix dedupe.ts to detect duplicates in overlapping uploads
input.body:
File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

The current implementation of `dedupe` in `src/ingest/dedupe.ts` doesn't correctly handle transactions that appear in overlapping statement uploads. It should be enhanced to recognize duplicates across the boundary days of each statement uploaded closely together, ensuring that transactions occurring within overlapping days are correctly identified and counted as duplicates. This will prevent double entries when two statements with overlapping date ranges are uploaded in quick succession.

The current implementation of `dedupe` in `src/ingest/dedupe.ts` doesn't correctly handle transactions that appear in overlapping statement uploads. It should be enhanced to recognize duplicates across the boundary days of each statement uploaded closely together, ensuring that transactions occurring within overlapping days are correctly identified and counted as duplicates. This will prevent double entries when two statements with overlapping date ranges are uploaded in quick succession.
